items.headline: Lithium price 'chill' returns, JPMorgan downgrades Albemarle (ALB.US) earnings forecast and cuts target price to $140
items.snippet: Albemarle's Greenbushes CGP3 plant in Australia continues to face delays after a fire in June. JPMorgan believes that Albemarle's current stock price is close to its target price, and the valuation is reasonable for a high-quality but volatile lithium producer.

items.headline: Albemarle (ALB) Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
items.snippet: Management of Albemarle Corporation (NYSE:ALB) reported growth in net sales and profitability for the second quarter, driven by pricing strength in the lithium and bromine markets. Lithium demand is up 45% through May, primarily driven by continued strength in stationary storage.

items.headline: Albemarle Corporation - Albemarle Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results
items.snippet: Sales volumes are expected to be in the range of 225 to 235 kilotons lithium carbonate equivalent, as increased Wodgina volumes partially offset a delay in the Talison CGP3 ramp due to a fire that occurred on June 9.
